controls.statement: Release identifier, source commits, artifact digests, configuration versions, migrations, and flag states.
controls.primary_reason: These release identity fields have exact values and immutable bindings, so a final package can be checked for completeness and consistency with source, artifact, configuration, migration, and flag authorities.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package records the release identifier, every source commit, configuration version, migration version, and feature-flag state required by the release manifest.
Every packaged artifact digest matches the artifact authority and is bound to the recorded source and release identifier.

controls.statement: Final scope and architecture diagrams.
controls.primary_reason: Final scope and architecture diagrams are versioned package records whose declared final status, release binding, and nonempty content can be validated exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains a nonempty final-scope record and versioned architecture diagrams bound to the exact release identifier.

controls.statement: Data inventory and data-flow records.
controls.primary_reason: Data inventory and data-flow records are exact required package entries, so their presence, versions, stable identifiers, and release binding can be checked.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains versioned data-inventory and data-flow records bound to the exact release identifier.

controls.statement: Threat model and abuse-case assessment.
controls.primary_reason: The package requirement is satisfied by versioned threat-model and abuse-case assessment records; their existence, review state, revision, and release binding are objective metadata.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains a nonempty threat model and abuse-case assessment with revision, owner, completed review record, and exact release binding.

controls.statement: Requirements-to-test traceability.
controls.primary_reason: With authoritative requirement and test inventories, each required trace link can be joined exactly to current test evidence for the same release.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every requirement in the approved release scope has one or more stable test identifiers in the traceability matrix.
Every referenced test identifier resolves to authenticated current results bound to the exact release artifact.

controls.statement: Functional and user-acceptance test results.
controls.primary_reason: Functional and user-acceptance result sets are exact package artifacts whose test identifiers, outcomes, timestamps, approvals, and release bindings can be validated.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains authenticated functional and user-acceptance test results for the approved test inventories, bound to the exact release.

controls.statement: Browser, device, localization, and accessibility results.
controls.primary_reason: The four named result categories form a closed package requirement, allowing presence, version, outcome, freshness, and release binding to be checked for each.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains current browser, device, localization, and accessibility result records for the approved matrices, bound to the exact release.

controls.statement: Performance, load, stress, endurance, and capacity results.
controls.primary_reason: The five named performance result types are exact package entries, so current authenticated result records can be checked against approved scenario identifiers and the release.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains current performance, load, stress, endurance, and capacity result records for the approved scenarios, bound to the exact release.

controls.statement: Resilience, failover, rollback, and recovery results.
controls.primary_reason: Resilience, failover, rollback, and recovery are a closed result list whose evidence records and release bindings can be validated without rejudging their adequacy.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains current authenticated resilience, failover, rollback, and recovery results for the approved scenario registry.

controls.statement: Security scan and penetration-test results.
controls.primary_reason: Security scan and penetration-test result records have stable tool, scope, time, outcome, artifact, and report identifiers that can be validated exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains current authenticated security-scan and penetration-test result records scoped and bound to the exact release artifact.

controls.statement: SBOM, license report, provenance, and artifact-signature evidence.
controls.primary_reason: SBOM, license, provenance, and signature evidence are machine-verifiable artifacts whose subject digest and release binding can be compared exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains an SBOM, license report, and provenance statement whose subject digest equals the release artifact digest.
The artifact signature verifies under the approved trust policy and covers the exact release artifact digest.

controls.statement: Vulnerability disposition and known-exploitation review.
controls.primary_reason: For every vulnerability in the authoritative findings inventory, disposition fields and a dated known-exploitation review can be required and joined exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every open or resolved vulnerability finding has a disposition record and a current known-exploitation review bound to its stable finding identifier.

controls.statement: Infrastructure and production-configuration review.
controls.primary_reason: Infrastructure and production-configuration review records have exact subjects, revisions, reviewers, decisions, and release bindings that can be checked.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains completed review records for the exact infrastructure revision and production-configuration version used by the release.

controls.statement: Backup and restoration evidence.
controls.primary_reason: Backup and restoration evidence is an exact required package entry whose scenario, result, time, recovery point, and environment bindings can be validated.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains current authenticated backup and restoration evidence for every scenario in the approved recovery test inventory.

controls.statement: Incident-response and continuity drill evidence.
controls.primary_reason: Incident-response and continuity drill evidence has exact scenario, participant, timestamp, outcome, and action-record fields, making package presence and binding decidable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains current authenticated incident-response and continuity drill records for the approved drill scenarios.

controls.statement: Monitoring, alert, dashboard, on-call, and runbook review.
controls.primary_reason: The five named operational areas form a closed review list, so completed review records for each area, their subjects, reviewers, and dates can be checked.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains completed current reviews for monitoring, alerts, dashboards, on-call arrangements, and runbooks.

controls.statement: Third-party risk and contract review.
controls.primary_reason: Third-party risk and contract review occurrence is objective when every approved provider record links to current authenticated review decisions.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every third party in the authoritative release inventory has current completed risk and contract review records in the package.

controls.statement: Open defect list.
controls.primary_reason: An open-defect list is an exact snapshot that can be required even when empty, with stable defect identifiers, status, time, and release scope.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains an authenticated open-defect snapshot for the exact release, explicitly listing every open defect or declaring none.

controls.statement: Open risk and exception register.
controls.primary_reason: An open risk and exception register is an exact release snapshot whose existence, entries, stable identifiers, and explicit empty state can be checked.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains an authenticated open-risk and exception snapshot for the exact release, listing every entry or explicitly declaring none.

controls.statement: Every exception’s owner, compensating control, expiry, and remediation plan.
controls.primary_reason: The four named exception fields are exact required metadata, so every exception entry can be checked for a resolvable owner, control, expiry, and remediation plan.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every exception in the authoritative register has a resolvable owner, nonempty compensating control, valid expiry, and versioned remediation plan.

controls.statement: Deployment, rollback, and post-deployment validation plans.
controls.primary_reason: Deployment, rollback, and post-deployment validation plans are a closed set of versioned release records whose presence and exact release binding can be validated.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains nonempty deployment, rollback or roll-forward, and post-deployment validation plans bound to the exact release.

controls.statement: Approval record and decision rationale.
controls.primary_reason: Approval record and rationale are exact package fields; authenticated decision, actor, authority, time, subject, and nonempty rationale can be checked.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The package contains an authenticated approval decision and nonempty rationale from an authorized decision-maker, bound to the exact release.

controls.statement: Product owner: scope, behavior, acceptance criteria, launch objectives, and customer impact.
controls.primary_reason: A product sign-off is objectively present when an authorized product owner signs the exact release and explicitly covers the five named product areas.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized product owner has an authenticated sign-off for the exact release covering scope, behavior, acceptance criteria, launch objectives, and customer impact.

controls.statement: Engineering owner: architecture, code, tests, migrations, maintainability, and technical risk.
controls.primary_reason: An engineering sign-off can be validated by signer authority, release subject, revision, time, and explicit coverage of the six named engineering areas.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized engineering owner has an authenticated sign-off for the exact release covering architecture, code, tests, migrations, maintainability, and technical risk.

controls.statement: Quality owner: test completeness, evidence, defects, and regression status.
controls.primary_reason: A quality sign-off is an accountable human decision record whose authorized signer, exact release, and four required coverage fields can be checked.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized quality owner has an authenticated sign-off for the exact release covering test completeness, evidence, defects, and regression status.

controls.statement: Security owner: threat model, ASVS coverage, findings, supply chain, and residual security risk.
controls.primary_reason: The evaluator need not redo security judgment; it can exactly validate that the authorized security owner signed the release and covered all five named subjects.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized security owner has an authenticated sign-off for the exact release covering threat model, ASVS coverage, findings, supply chain, and residual security risk.

controls.statement: Reliability or operations owner: SLOs, capacity, monitoring, on-call, rollout, rollback, and recovery.
controls.primary_reason: The required operations sign-off is an authenticated decision record with a closed seven-area coverage list and exact release binding.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized reliability or operations owner has signed the exact release covering SLOs, capacity, monitoring, on-call, rollout, rollback, and recovery.

controls.statement: Data owner: integrity, migration, retention, reconciliation, and recovery.
controls.primary_reason: The data-owner sign-off can be checked for authorized identity, exact release subject, and explicit coverage of the five named data areas.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized data owner has an authenticated sign-off for the exact release covering integrity, migration, retention, reconciliation, and recovery.

controls.statement: Privacy owner: data inventory, purpose, rights, notices, transfers, and privacy risk.
controls.primary_reason: The privacy decision remains human-owned, while the scanner can deterministically validate that an authorized privacy owner signed and covered the six named areas.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized privacy owner has an authenticated sign-off for the exact release covering inventory, purpose, rights, notices, transfers, and privacy risk.

controls.statement: Accessibility owner or qualified reviewer: target conformance and unresolved barriers.
controls.primary_reason: An authoritative role or qualification registry plus the sign-off record makes signer eligibility, release binding, and the two required coverage fields exact.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized accessibility owner or currently qualified reviewer has signed the exact release covering target conformance and unresolved barriers.

controls.statement: Legal or compliance owner: applicable obligations, terms, contracts, and regulatory risks.
controls.primary_reason: Legal conclusions are not automated, but occurrence of the required authorized legal or compliance sign-off and its four coverage fields is objectively verifiable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized legal or compliance owner has signed the exact release covering applicable obligations, terms, contracts, and regulatory risks.

controls.statement: Support owner: support readiness, escalation, documentation, and customer communications.
controls.primary_reason: The support sign-off record can be checked exactly for authorized identity, release subject, timestamp, and coverage of all four named readiness areas.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized support owner has signed the exact release covering support readiness, escalation, documentation, and customer communications.

controls.statement: Business risk owner: explicit acceptance of remaining material risk.
controls.primary_reason: Risk acceptance itself remains accountable human authority; the scanner only validates that the authorized business risk owner explicitly signed the exact remaining material-risk set.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: An authorized business risk owner has an authenticated explicit acceptance record bound to every remaining material risk and the exact release.

controls.statement: Executive or designated release authority: final go/no-go decision for high-impact launches.
controls.primary_reason: For releases classified high-impact by authoritative policy, an authenticated final go or no-go decision by the designated release authority is exact evidence.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every release marked high-impact has an authenticated final go or no-go decision from the executive or designated release authority.

controls.statement: Every applicable release-blocking item passes.
controls.primary_reason: Given authoritative applicability and blocker policies, every applicable release-blocking control can be enumerated and its current terminal result compared exactly with pass.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The approved decision policy identifies every applicable release-blocking item for the exact release.
Every identified blocking item has a current authenticated pass result bound to the exact release artifact.

controls.statement: Every critical requirement has current evidence tied to the exact production artifact.
controls.primary_reason: Critical requirements, evidence freshness, and production artifact digests are exact data, so every required evidence binding can be joined and verified.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The authoritative release scope identifies every critical requirement and the freshness policy that applies to its evidence.
Every critical requirement has current authenticated evidence whose subject digest equals the exact production artifact digest.

controls.statement: Every accepted risk has an accountable owner and expiration.
controls.primary_reason: Owner and expiration are exact required fields, so every accepted-risk record can be checked for a resolvable accountable owner and valid future expiry.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every accepted risk has an authenticated acceptance record, resolvable accountable owner, and valid expiration date.

controls.statement: Required sign-offs are complete.
controls.primary_reason: The authoritative sign-off matrix supplies a closed required set, allowing every signature's identity, authority, release binding, timestamp, and completion state to be checked.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every sign-off required by the approved release matrix is authenticated, complete, authorized, current, and bound to the exact release.

controls.statement: A named risk owner accepts the issue.
controls.primary_reason: A named owner's acceptance is an exact accountable decision record whose identity, authority, issue subject, timestamp, and acceptance can be validated.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The issue has an authenticated explicit acceptance from a resolvable authorized risk owner, bound to the exact issue revision and release.

controls.statement: A near-term remediation date and automatic expiry exist.
controls.primary_reason: A remediation date and automatic expiry are exact fields and behaviors, so both can be validated against policy and exercised with a bounded expired fixture.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The issue record contains a valid near-term remediation date and an exact automatic-expiry timestamp meeting the approved maximum duration.
A bounded expired fixture proves the exception becomes invalid automatically after its expiry timestamp.

controls.statement: Evidence is missing or stale.
controls.primary_reason: Required evidence and freshness windows are explicit in the approved evidence policy, making missing references and stale timestamps exact no-go conditions.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The approved release evidence policy enumerates every required evidence item and its exact freshness rule.
The decision evaluator reports no-go when any required evidence item is absent, unresolved, or older than its freshness limit.

controls.statement: A critical control is assumed rather than tested.
controls.primary_reason: Critical controls and acceptable tested-evidence types are explicit policy inputs, so an assertion without matching execution evidence is objectively identifiable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The approved decision policy enumerates every critical control and its required execution-evidence type.
The evaluator reports no-go when any critical control has only an assertion or review record and lacks current matching test evidence.

controls.statement: Rollback, restoration, or incident response is unavailable.
controls.primary_reason: An approved readiness policy can define availability evidence for rollback, restoration, and incident response, allowing current mechanism, access, and exercise records to be checked exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The readiness policy defines the required current availability evidence for rollback, restoration, and incident-response mechanisms.
The evaluator reports no-go when any required mechanism, access binding, or current exercise record is absent or failed.

controls.statement: Required legal or contractual approval is absent.
controls.primary_reason: Legal or contractual authority determines the applicable approval set; once recorded, absence of any required authenticated approval is an exact condition.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every legal or contractual approval in the authoritative applicability register has a current authenticated approval record bound to the exact release.
